ideas.pitch: A localized forecasting and risk assessment tool for the River Wear in Durham, using historical hydrological data and Poisson regression to predict localized flood incidents and infrastructure strain.
ideas.title: Durham Historic Flood and Drainage Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the pattern of winning AI incident forecasting by applying rigorous modeling to a localized physical safety problem that directly impacts the Durham community and university area.

ideas.pitch: An automated auditing platform for Durham University student union grants and club treasuries, combining graph intelligence and anomaly detection to flag high-risk transactions or compliance issues.
ideas.title: Student Society Grant and AML Risk Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges and student organizers feel directly by automating the tedious compliance and auditing process for university societies.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent platform that connects independent Durham student freelancers and local independent shops with secure escrow-backed micro-payments.
ideas.title: Durham Local Business Autonomous Micro-Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear local economic benefit and taps into the proven winning pattern of autonomous agent marketplaces with secure settlement mechanics.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered logistics app that groups elderly residents in County Durham into shared social outings and pairs them with verified student volunteer drivers.
ideas.title: Wearside Senior Community Transport Dispatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets concrete social impact with a quantified community benefit, mirroring the grand prize winner at the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered guest acquisition and verified review trust engine tailored for Durham college formals, catering services, and student-run formals coordination.
ideas.title: Durham College Formal & Event Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on a proven trust-engine framework while targeting a deeply familiar local pain point for students organizing college balls and formals.
